title: Stem Changes with Plural Possessed Nouns

sections.content:
Nouns ending in a short vowel undergo regular vowel lengthening or dropping before plural possession suffixes:
- *ruha* → **ruháim** (my clothes), *kefe* → **keféim** (my brushes).
- Irregular and fleeting-vowel stems: *dolog* → **dolgaim**, *szülő* → **szüleim**.
- Remember that the plural possessed suffix already includes the plurality of the objects: never say *barátaimok*!

items.spanish: A szobám tiszta, de a ruháim még a székeken hevernek.
items.english: My room is clean, but my clothes are lying on the chairs.

items.spanish: Minden fontos dolgom a táskámban van.
items.english: All my important things are in my bag.
